subject.title: message_tool_only: withheld finals stay in the agent's context as normal turns, desynchronizing agent memory from what the user saw

question: For `message_tool_only` private finals that are withheld from the source channel, should OpenClaw replay the full text with an undelivered marker, replace it with a short delivery-status notice, or rely only on stranded-final recovery?
rationale: The runtime can detect the mismatch, but the durable replay shape affects privacy, model behavior, transcript semantics, and how it composes with the open recovery PR.

options.title: Annotate withheld replay
options.body: Keep the private final available for continuity but add a clear model-visible system/status marker that it was not delivered to the user.

options.title: Replace replayed final
options.body: Remove the withheld text from model-visible history and preserve only a short undelivered notice, reducing phantom-history risk at the cost of losing useful working state.

options.title: Defer to recovery PR
options.body: Treat active stranded-final recovery as sufficient for now and leave historical withheld finals unmarked, accepting continued desync risk when recovery does not run or predates the fix.

recommendation.title: Annotate withheld replay
recommendation.body: Keep the private final available for continuity but add a clear model-visible system/status marker that it was not delivered to the user.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent per-turn delivery-contract work is the closest current owner boundary for deciding how `message_tool_only` turns should appear to the model.
